verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only per-file sharing primitives. The Drive API supports permission types (user, group, domain, anyone) and roles, and individual users can choose edit, comment or view access, with folder access inherited by contained files. These are developer building blocks and user-level controls, not org-level admin governance. Nothing in the pack documents admin policies restricting external sharing, domain allowlists, or org-wide link-sharing restrictions, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.
